what: Hovering a text link or pill button tilts the current text slanted (.15) and flattens it to .25× vertically as it slides 20px up and out, while the same text in the same shape rises from 20px below and straightens (.3s cubic-bezier(0,.55,.45,1), opacity linear) — on release it returns at once. A roll where the letters fold over like paper.

options.data-text: Same text (required) — the second text rising from below. Put the first text inside as a single span
options.--fx-shift: Out-and-in travel distance (px number, no unit), default 20
options.[data-fx-part=host]: When the hover panel is not a link·button (e.g. a name row inside a card), put it on that panel

use: Treatment Guide

from.where: shared.css .yd-roll (pill button, text button, booking pill, menu button text, service card name line, Social link) — original .button__text:after{content:attr(data-text)} · matrix(1,.15,-.15,.25,0,±20) · only on :hover transition transform .3s cubic-bezier(0,.55,.45,1), opacity .3s linear
